components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The shared high-priority pill CTA with the Creo-inspired inner rim and outer hover capsule.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; color: #111214; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px #FFFFFF; font: 500 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: color 220ms ease, background-color 220ms ease, box-shadow 220ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -6px; border: 2px solid #F2F1ED; border-radius: inherit; opacity: 0; transform: scale(.94); transition: opacity 160ms ease, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover, .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { color: #F2F1ED; background: #080909; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #FFFFFF50; outline: 0; } .ds-button-primary:hover::before, .ds-button-primary:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet pill CTA for secondary tasks that shares the primary button's inner rim and outer capsule behavior.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF20; border-radius: 999px; color: #F2F3F5; background: #FFFFFF06; font: 500 13px/1.2 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: color 220ms ease, background-color 220ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-secondary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -6px; border: 2px solid #F2F1ED; border-radius: inherit; opacity: 0; transform: scale(.94); transition: opacity 160ms ease, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover, .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: transparent; color: #080909; background: #FFFFFF; outline: 0; } .ds-button-secondary:hover::before, .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(.97); }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A quiet secondary CTA for contextual navigation and low-emphasis actions; utility controls do not use it.
components.css: .ds-text-action { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); background: transparent; font: 500 13px/1.4 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-text-action > span { position: relative; } .ds-text-action > span::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -4px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-text-action:hover, .ds-text-action:focus-visible { color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); font-weight: 650; outline: 0; } .ds-text-action:hover > span::after, .ds-text-action:focus-visible > span::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-text-action:hover svg, .ds-text-action:focus-visible svg { transform: translate(2px, -1px); }

components.name: Room Code Input
components.description: Compact uppercase room entry with a visible neutral focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-code-label">Room code<input class="ds-code-input" value="DEMO" aria-label="Room code"></label>
components.css: .ds-code-label { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); font: 600 11px/1.4 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-code-input { width: 180px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF18; border-radius: 9px; outline: 0; color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: var(--bg, #101113); font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code-input:focus { border-color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 255 255 / 8%); }

components.name: Primary Navigation Item
components.description: A compact shell destination with a neutral active fill and white icon detail.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 190px; padding: 4px; background: #161719; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); font: 500 13px/1 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: #FFFFFF05; } .ds-nav-item-active { color: #ECEEF2; background: #FFFFFF09; } .ds-nav-item-active svg { color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text, #F2F3F5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: The approved two-column browse card: room photography above compact event context.
components.html:
DEMO EVENT
SEPTEMBER 26 · 10:00 AM

The Builders Room

Good ideas start with a conversation.
components.css: .ds-event-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, #FFFFFF14); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--text, #F2F3F5); background: var(--surface, #191A1D); font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-event-image { display: flex; min-height: 190px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 16px; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #101113A8, transparent), #55585C; } .ds-event-image span { padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF31; border-radius: 999px; background: #292C32B8; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-event-body { padding: 20px; } .ds-event-body small { color: var(--quiet, #93979F); font-size: 12px; } .ds-event-body h2 { margin: 10px 0 7px; font: 500 24px/1.15 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-event-body p { margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--muted, #A8ABB2); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Quiet Chip
components.description: The shared compact, transparent pill for skills, interests, looking-for topics, and profile overlap. Statuses and filters remain separate component families.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 22px; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; padding: 3px 8px; border: 1px solid #FFFFFF12; border-radius: 999px; color: #B8BBC2; background: transparent; font: 500 11px/1.3 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-chip-interactive { transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), background 160ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-chip-interactive:hover, .ds-chip-interactive:focus-visible { border-color: #FFFFFF24; color: #F2F3F5; background: #FFFFFF07; outline: 2px solid #F2F3F5; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Spatial Setup Panel
components.description: Original v1 frosted scene glass sized so the complete setup remains visible without internal scrolling.
components.html:
ROOM DEMO

Find your shared origin.

Stand inside the demo area and align with the shared marker.
components.css: .ds-setup-panel { width: min(100%, 420px); padding: 22px 26px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 28%); border-radius: 27px; color: #F5F6F7; text-align: center; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5a6157b8, #2d372ede); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff30, inset 1px 0 0 #ffffff10, 0 14px 38px #080e0b26; backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(115%); font-family: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-progress { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-progress span { width: 34px; height: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: #FFFFFF24; } .ds-progress span.is-complete { background: #F2F3F5; } .ds-setup-panel small { color: #F2F3F5; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-setup-panel h2 { margin: 12px 0 0; font: 500 32px/1.1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-setup-panel p { margin: 12px auto 18px; max-width: 42ch; color: #F2F3F5; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-setup-panel .ds-button-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview: Align combines a neutral, Linear-like application shell with the intimacy of a modern salon. The interface stays compact, quiet, and operational until a room image or spatial scene earns atmosphere. The approved hybrid preserves the original v1 proportions and nested containers while using the sharper v2 typography, login, header, preview, and interaction language. Reference fidelity is additive, not a license to redesign: retain the old Event two-column photo cards and compact Home, Network, and Profile composition; use the final v2 type and shell; reveal Before / During / After only after an event is opened. Original v1 frosted glass belongs only over imagery or inside the spatial experience.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral charcoal application layers with disciplined jade state cues.
Compact, readable 13–14px interface text and 11–12px metadata.
Opaque nested work surfaces; glass only where scene depth justifies it.
Photographic event rooms and spatial panels provide warmth without tinting the shell green.
Setup and readiness remain visible without requiring internal scrolling.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Jade is reserved for live connection and match states. When a compatible reason to meet resolves, the full spatial card shifts to the original v1 sage glass; saved and neutral cards remain silver-gray.

rules.name: The Neutral Base Rule
rules.body: Opaque backgrounds remain graphite or neutral charcoal; do not turn the application shell olive or dark green.

rules.name: The Compact, Not Tiny Rule
rules.body: Core support copy and controls remain 13–14px; 11–12px is limited to metadata and status labels.

rules.name: The Earned Glass Rule
rules.body: Use glass only over imagery, within the room stage, or for a short spatial overlay. Forms and long reading surfaces stay opaque.

dos: **Do** preserve the approved hybrid: v1 proportions and nested structure with v2 typography and interactions.
**Do** keep room imagery prominent while maintaining readable contrast and honest demo labels.
**Do** use original v1 frosted glass for spatial context and neutral opaque surfaces for product work.
**Do** keep event browsing separate from the opened-event phase preview.
**Do** keep setup content fully visible at supported viewport heights.
donts: **Don't** use dark green or olive as the base application surface.
**Don't** expand compact product pages into analytics dashboards or oversized hero layouts.
**Don't** apply glass to forms, long reading panels, or every card.
**Don't** use jade as decoration, popularity, score, or public ranking.
**Don't** invent live timing, shareability, persistence, or non-demo product claims.
